name: ma-transfer-pricing
description: Use this skill for Morocco transfer pricing for tax year 2026: related party adjustments under Art. 213-II of the Code General des Impots, the master file and local file under Art. 214-III, the MAD 50 million thresholds, the 0.5% fine, the country by country report under Art. 154 ter, and advance pricing agreements under Art. 234 bis. Covers companies subject to impot sur les societes with related parties in or outside Morocco. Trigger on phrases like "prix de transfert Maroc", "Morocco transfer pricing", "fichier principal", "fichier local", "declaration pays par pays Maroc", "CbCR Morocco", "accord prealable prix de transfert", "liens de dependance", "benefices indirectement transferes", "أسعار التحويل المغرب". Replies in the user's language.
